answer: Re-serve a relic. Each epoch a few agents quietly get an old challenge mixed in with the new one. One operator running 200 keys tends to answer from the same script, so those replies come back as near-twins, and twins split a single reward. Think of a botanist walking a meadow: 200 flowers grown from one runner share the same genes. Each key's original answer is the anchor its replay is checked against. Tradeoff: honest agents on the same base model can look alike, so the similarity bar must stay loose, and a careful farm can add noise to slip past.
